game.title: Marvel's Spider-Man 2
game.blurb: Open-world superhero action-adventure from Insomniac Games, released 2023-10-20 (PC port by Nixxes Software). RAWG average playtime: 26 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Peter and Miles against the new threats to New York. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Districts and Side Activities
chapters.summary: Tech Stashes, neighbourhood requests, EMF experiments, Photo Ops, Spider-Bots and side stories.

chapters.title: Suits, Gadgets and Upgrades
chapters.summary: Levelling up, buying suits, suit tech and gadget upgrades, and collecting Tech Parts.

chapters.title: Combat and Traversal
chapters.summary: Venom and Spider Arm abilities, stealth takedowns, air tricks and Web Wings.

chapters.title: Completion and New Game+
chapters.summary: Finishing the story again in New Game+ and earning every achievement.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 2651280)
StrategyWiki: stub page only, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Marvel's_Spider-Man_2
Fandom (marvels-spider-man.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://marvels-spider-man.fandom.com/wiki/Marvel's_Spider-Man_2
notes: StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0); Walkthrough, Gameplay and Trophies subpages are linked but not written (only Controls and Table of Contents subpages exist). marvels-spider-man.fandom.com (Marvel's Spider-Man Wiki) answers the API, with about 81 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Popsicle" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 2651280. 16 of 43 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in the main story chapter. Some of them may be side-story finales rather than main missions.
